title: game/data/festivals.json: Copperleaf's festivals and market days (hub track HB-10e; logic/festival.js)

cur.description: what the festival market is paid in: a currency kept between runs (currencies.json, kept: meta)

kind.description: milestone: while `when` holds (a story condition, read on the run history); date: from `from` (MM-DD, the phone's calendar by the ranch clock) for `days`; market: every `every` returns (meta.runs). A milestone goes before a date, a date before a market day

when.description: milestone: the condition that holds while it is on (no festival: in it)

days.description: date: how many days it lasts

every.description: market: on every this-many-th return (meta.runs a multiple of it)

about.description: the notice board's line while it is on, and the toast when you come home to it

day.description: the square's day while it is on, in place of rules.json square.day (logic/square-day.js); its slot keys are its own (the goers are kept per key)

stock.description: the festival market's wares: an item (items.json) or a coin (pyramids.json), how many it has each time the festival is on, the price in `cur`
